ApiKey.description: Public metadata only. The bearer secret is never stored or returned here.

port.description: Omit/null to allocate an unassigned managed host port.

DeletedServer.description: Completed deletion. Retained files are never implicitly adopted by a new instance.

HostCapacity.description: Docker engine totals, not free resources or the manager container's limits.

items.description: Public metadata only. The bearer secret is never stored or returned here.

RecoveryPolicyRequest.description: Requests retain serde defaults; policy responses always include all fields.

ServerMetrics.description:
Point-in-time container measurements. Missing measurements are null, never
invented zeroes. CPU is percent of one logical core and may exceed 100.

info.description: Single-owner REST API. Cookie sessions or owner API keys; trusted mode retains Host, Origin and CSRF checks. Binary transfers and WebSocket upgrades use native HTTP. MCP JSON-RPC is a separate protocol at /mcp.
